caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally-placed object: a lidded tureen or serving dish. The tureen has an octagonal body with two curved handles, one on each side, and a matching octagonal lid featuring a finial on top that appears to be leaf-shaped. The object is shown in gray pencil on an off-white or light beige background. The shading is soft and gradual, particularly on the body of the tureen, which emphasizes its rounded surface and faceted edges. There is a rectangular border drawn with thin lines to frame the composition, and the artist’s signature is visible in the lower right corner within the border. The drawing uses a monochromatic gray scale without any additional color.
title: Sugar Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
